Unfolding across the horizontal crease mirrors the triangle into a larger triangle centered on the vertical midline; unfolding across the vertical crease mirrors it again across the horizontal midline. The four reflected triangles combine into a single square hole rotated 45° (a diamond) at the center of the paper — with no notches on the edges.
